selection_policy: Primary-source records only. Access notes distinguish public readability from permission to redistribute. Downloaded entries must record local paths, SHA-256 evidence, retrieval date, and an article/figure license determination.

entries.title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
entries.license_or_access_note: Freely accessible author preprint on arXiv; public access does not by itself establish a permissive figure-reuse license, so inspect the record's license metadata before redistribution.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Canonical U-shaped network architecture with a contracting path, symmetric expanding path, convolution/ReLU blocks, pooling, up-convolution, and copy-and-crop skip connections.
entries.why_representative: A dense but regular neural-network diagram that tests repeated modules, orthogonal connectors, arrows, skip links, layer annotations, and exact spatial alignment; it is well suited to deliberate vector redraw after PDF object census.

entries.title: TOmicsVis: An all-in-one transcriptomic analysis and visualization R package with Shinyapp interface
entries.license_or_access_note: The local JATS full text records CC BY 4.0, and the Figure 2 caption has no separate third-party exclusion. The published figure is admitted only as a locked QA reference; the five repository data files have a separate, conflicting upstream license record that still needs manual review.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Eight-panel statistical visualization suite containing a quantile plot, box plot, violin plot, survival curve, correlation heatmap, PCA with a 95% confidence region, t-SNE plot, and hierarchical dendrogram.
entries.why_representative: It concentrates common publication graphics in one figure and is backed by an open analysis package and built-in example datasets, making data-driven regeneration preferable to tracing plotted pixels.

entries.title: ML-ROM wall shear stress prediction in patient-specific vascular pathologies under a limited clinical training data regime
entries.license_or_access_note: Open-access PLOS ONE version of record; the article is distributed under the Creative Commons Attribution License stated by PLOS.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Three patient-specific aortic surface renderings compare predicted time-averaged wall shear stress, the original CFD result, and their spatial difference.
entries.why_representative: The vascular geometry, camera, lighting, continuous color field, and shared color-scale semantics make this a realistic 3D scientific figure; without the source mesh and field arrays, the surface pixels should remain atomic while labels and scale furniture are rebuilt as vectors.

entries.title: In situ elemental analyses of living biological specimens using ‘NanoSuit’ and EDS methods in FE-SEM
entries.license_or_access_note: Open-access Scientific Reports version of record; the article's Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license notice governs reuse.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: A ten-panel SEM/EDS comparison of Aloe leaf slices prepared by NanoSuit and conventional fixation, including Ca, Na, P, and Os elemental maps plus EDS line scans.
entries.why_representative: It combines irreplaceable microscopy evidence, false-color elemental overlays, line-scan plots, inset observation fields, and repeated panel labels, so a hybrid treatment is necessary to preserve scientific pixels while vectorizing explanatory layers.

entries.title: Pre-clinical evaluation of advanced nerve guide conduits using a novel 3D in vitro testing model
entries.license_or_access_note: Public full text in PubMed Central under the article's Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 license; commercial reuse requires separate review.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: A two-part experimental-setup figure pairs a labeled schematic of the 3D culture model with a photograph of the assembled nerve-guide conduit, adapter, perforated plate, medium, and well plate.
entries.why_representative: This is a compact example of a photo-plus-schematic layout where the apparatus photograph must remain faithful but the diagram, number callouts, leaders, and typography can be rebuilt as editable vectors.

entries.title: nnU-Net–based Segmentation of Tumor Subcompartments in Pediatric Medulloblastoma Using Multiparametric MRI: A Multi-institutional Study
entries.license_or_access_note: The publisher page and a PubMed Central copy provide public full text; the page carries RSNA copyright, so public access must not be treated as permission to redistribute the figure.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Rows A–D and E–H show good and poor segmentations from site A; columns compare the original MRI, expert reference label, direct-learning nnU-Net result, and transfer-learning nnU-Net result for several tumor subcompartments.
entries.why_representative: It tests preservation of diagnostic grayscale pixels, categorical masks, repeated row/column structure, color semantics, and accuracy annotations; the medical images and masks should be treated as evidence-bearing raster layers.

entries.title: Land-Use and Land-Cover Classification in Semi-Arid Areas from Medium-Resolution Remote-Sensing Imagery: A Deep Learning Approach
entries.license_or_access_note: Open-access MDPI Sensors version of record; the article's Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 license notice governs reuse.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Six-panel land-use/land-cover comparison for Lahore and Faisalabad: false-color Sentinel-2 composites alongside classification maps from trained 4-band and 10-band CNN models.
entries.why_representative: The figure represents map-like categorical raster outputs with a fixed class palette, geographically meaningful textures, and repeated site/model comparisons; raster classifications are preserved while legends, site labels, borders, and panel letters are vectorized.

entries.title: Using a Microfluidic Device for High-Content Analysis of Cell Signaling
entries.license_or_access_note: A free author manuscript is available in PubMed Central; the article remains under AAAS copyright, and repository access does not grant a permissive redistribution license.
entries.figure_caption_or_summary: Device-design schematic showing the complete 21 × 40 mm chip, a blue upper valve layer, red lower fluidic layer, drilled interface holes, a double-layer cross-section, and labeled major device parts.
entries.why_representative: A representative process/mechanism drawing with color-coded functional layers, channel geometry, cross-sectional reasoning, dimensions, and labels that can be reconstructed cleanly as editable paths and live text.
